hooks.command: OUTPUT=$(python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/novel_check.py" 2>&1); EXIT=$?; echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] exit=$EXIT" >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/logs/hook.log"; echo "$OUTPUT" >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/logs/hook.log"; if [ $EXIT -ne 0 ]; then echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -E '❌|不合格|缺失|重复|建议重写|大纲' | head -10; echo '{"systemMessage": "全检未通过！请修复问题后再继续。字数差>200建议重写场景，不要逐句追加。大纲缺失需先补大纲。", "continue": true}'; else echo '{"systemMessage": "全检通过", "continue": true}'; fi
hooks.statusMessage: 全量检查（正文+滑动+流程文档）...
